goal: Define a TodoItem interface and an in-memory store with add, getAll, and getById helpers.
scope_summary: Create src/store.ts exporting a TodoItem interface and a TodoStore class backed by a Map. The store's add method generates an id, defaults completed to false, and stamps createdAt/updatedAt. Add unit tests in tests/store.test.ts covering the two required test cases plus getById.
planned_changes: Create src/store.ts with TodoItem interface and TodoStore class (add, getAll, getById)
Create tests/store.test.ts with unit tests for model shape and insertion-order retrieval
acceptance_checks: TodoItem type has id, title, completed, createdAt, and updatedAt fields
In-memory store supports add, getAll, and getById operations
New items default completed to false and set createdAt/updatedAt
Unit test: store.test.ts > 'add returns an item with all required fields' verifies model shape
Unit test: store.test.ts > 'getAll returns items in insertion order' verifies ordering
commit_message: feat(F003): add TodoItem interface and in-memory store with unit tests
risks: ID generation strategy (crypto.randomUUID vs counter) — randomUUID requires Node 19+ or polyfill; counter is simpler but non-standard for APIs
Map iteration order is insertion-order in ES2015+, but the getAll test depends on this guarantee — must verify the implementation preserves it
createdAt/updatedAt use Date.now() or new Date() — tests that check exact timestamps may be flaky without freezing time
